description: This file defines the UsersViewList class, a view component responsible for displaying a list of users within the SuiteCRM application. It includes access control logic, search processing, and list rendering functionalities.

classes.name: UsersViewList
classes.description: A view class for listing user records with access control and search capabilities.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Performs access checks and initializes the list view before display.

methods.name: listViewProcess
methods.description: Processes search form input and renders the user list view accordingly.
